summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime from GitHub to execute obfuscated in-package bundle math_init.js
details: The package's preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) from GitHub releases to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-cjs bundle carrying obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (rotator WV8StW over a ~1500-entry literal array, decoder hc1jfK9 over a custom charset) whose contents cannot be inspected without executing it under Bun. The bundle's filename does not correspond to any tag-management functionality, and it is only ever invoked by the preinstall dropper. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute a heavily obfuscated in-package payload evades Node-only static analysis and hands arbitrary code execution to the installer's machine during npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
